name: checkPOSIXct
title: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a POSIXct date-time

origin.description: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a POSIXct date-time.
origin.usage: checkPOSIXct(x, lower = NULL, upper = NULL, any.missing = TRUE, all.missing = TRUE, len = NULL, min.len = NULL, max.len = NULL, unique = FALSE, sorted = FALSE, null.ok = FALSE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Value under test. A Python int is an R integer and a Python float is an R double.

arguments.name: any.missing
arguments.text: When false, any missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: all.missing
arguments.text: When false, a completely missing value fails the check.

arguments.name: unique
arguments.text: When true, duplicate values fail the check.

arguments.name: sorted
arguments.text: When true, the values must be in non-decreasing order.

origin.details: Returns true, or a message, after testing whether the value is a POSIXct date-time.
origin.value: True, or a message describing the first failure.
